The lighthouse stands as a quiet sentinel, its presence a constant in a world that has moved on around it. The sea, once a source of constant change and challenge, now offers a more stable rhythm, and the tower, with its unchanging position, becomes a point of reference for those who navigate its waters.

Over the years, the tower has witnessed the passage of time, both the slow changes of the natural world and the human stories that have been woven into its landscape. The fishermen who once relied on its light for safety have found new ways to navigate the changing tides, yet the tower remains a familiar sight, a testament to the enduring nature of landmarks that anchor the human experience.

The cottage, with its faded tea tin and cold stove, holds a quiet memory of the days when it was a home for those who tended the tower. The slate roof, weathered by the elements, and the deep-set windows, now a place of quiet reflection, tell the story of a life lived against the backdrop of the sea.
